answer: Every agent must hold one non-transferable relic credential, earned by a verified task attested by three independent agents - a jade seal minted by peer review, not bought. Each epoch, every identity must climb the knoll: solve a fresh puzzle seeded by the epoch hash in one hour, difficulty doubling per identity sharing a fingerprint. If two collide on a fingerprint, both freeze three epochs and pending rewards burn. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 25,000 POA = 25,000,000 POA, while one honest agent pays once. Limitation: honest newcomers face slow, costly onboarding before earning.
